title: Zesty Portuguese Custard Torta
description: A funky, gooey, kid-friendly Portuguese dessert featuring garlic granules and a raw egg-free version.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, milk, and butter.
Add the garlic granules and vanilla extract to the egg yolk mixture and whisk to combine.
Gradually pour the egg yolk mixture into the flour mixture and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove the torta from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Dust the torta with confectioners' sugar and sprinkle with cinnamon.
